items.title: Scalars aur vectors ka bunyadi tasawwur (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered opening section (PDF 23, printed 20).

blocks.text: Scalars aur vectors physics ki bunyadi (basic) cheezen hain. Physics ke bohat se sawalon mein pehle yeh pehchanna parta hai ke koi quantity scalar hai ya vector, taa ke us par sahi hisaab (mathematics) aur sahi soch lagayi ja sake. Scalars aur vectors samajh kar hum dekhte hain ke physics rozmarra ki zindagi mein kaise kaam aati hai, jaise kul tay kiya hua faasla (distance) nikalna, jo scalar hai, ya kisi force ki miqdar (magnitude) aur simt (direction) maloom karna, jo vector hai. Yeh cheezen seekhne se gehri soch (critical thinking) aur sawal hal karne ki salahiyat barhti hai.

Yeh chapter zyada tar vector algebra aur us ke istemal ke bare mein hai: seedhi lakeer mein yaksan acceleration (uniform acceleration) wali harkat, yaksan gravitational field mein azadana girte (freely falling) ajsam ki harkat, projectile motion, aur ek aur do dimensions mein ajsam ka aapas mein takrana (interaction).

blocks.caption: Is chapter mein kya hai
rows: scalars, vectors, components, scalar aur vector products (2.1 se 2.3)
equations of motion, gravity ke tahat harkat (2.4, 2.5)
momentum, impulse, elastic aur inelastic collisions, rocket propulsion (2.7 se 2.12)

blocks.prompt: Physics ko ek ke bajaye do qism ki quantities kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Kuch quantities sirf ek adad aur unit se poori bata di jati hain, jaise chala hua faasla. Kuch ke liye simt bhi batani parti hai, jaise darwaze par lagi force; inhen jama ya zarb karte waqt simt ka khayal rakhna parta hai. Is liye scalar aur vector ko alag rakhte hain, taa ke pata ho kaun sa hisaab lagana hai.

items: Scalar aur vector ka hisaab alag hota hai. Yeh chapter vector algebra, seedhi lakeer mein yaksan acceleration, free fall, projectile aur ek aur do dimensions mein collisions parhata hai.
